surfaces.name: ContinuityOS
observations: Drive contains ContinuityOS strategy/research corpus, including ContinuityOS_Master_Strategy_v1.8.docx.
A provider search restricted to post-2026-08-11 modifications found only shared aggregate surfaces such as the master dossier and HANRI dashboard, not an independent ContinuityOS runtime receipt.
Fresh source discovery therefore does not justify an OPERATIONAL/CURRENT claim.
missing_proof: fresh checkpoint/replay/recovery receipt from the active ContinuityOS operational surface
independent provider or host readback binding that receipt to the current target state
surfaces.promotion_rule: Promote only after a fresh operational checkpoint/replay receipt and independent target-state readback; corpus existence alone is insufficient.
